Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Lee, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands over his patient, Jack, who sits on a hospital bed, staring blankly into space 🤯. Dr. Lee holds out a small glass of medication, his expression firm but concerned 😬.

DR. LEE:
"Jack, it's time for your medication. Please take it, it's for your own good 💊."

JACK:
"I don't want it. I don't need it. I'm fine." 🙅‍♂️

DR. LEE:
"Jack, you know the risks. You know what it can do to your mind 🤯. You need to take it, for your own sanity." 😬

JACK:
"I'm not crazy, Doc. You're just trying to control me." 🚫

DR. LEE:
"That's not true, Jack. I'm trying to help you 🤝. Now, please, just take the pills." 💊

Jack refuses, and Dr. Lee's expression softens, his voice taking on a hint of desperation 🤕.

DR. LEE:
"Okay, fine. I'll take them myself, then." 💊

Dr. Lee picks up the glass and downs the pills in one swift motion 💥. He looks up, expecting to see Jack's vacant expression, but instead, he's met with... nothing 🌀.

DR. LEE:
"Jack? Jack, are you there?" 🤔

The room falls silent, except for the sound of Dr. Lee's own ragged breathing 💨. He looks around, disoriented, and that's when he sees it: a figure standing in the corner of the room, watching him 👀.

DR. LEE:
"Who are you?" 🤯

The figure doesn't respond, but instead, begins to fade away, like a ghost disappearing into thin air 👻.

DR. LEE:
"No... no, this can't be..." 😱

As the figure disappears, Dr. Lee's eyes widen in horror, and he realizes the truth: he's the one who's been delusional all along 🤯. The pills, the hospital, the entire world - it's all just a product of his own fractured mind 🌪️.

DR. LEE:
"(whispering to himself) I'm the one who's crazy... I'm the one who's been playing God..." 🤯

The camera zooms out, and we see Dr. Lee sitting alone in the empty room, his eyes fixed on the spot where Jack once was, a look of utter despair etched on his face 😩.

FADE TO BLACK 🎥
